reviews.text: We arrived in Japan from LA & brought Lilo here for a post-trip bath.  We added in the Japanese cypress hot bath to Lilo’s dog grooming service.  We are both happy when we picked up Lilo and how happy she was.  Pet Hills Aoyama location took pictures of Lilo & sent the pictures to us.  Thank you Pet Hills Aoyama!

I used their services for cat grooming. Upon arrival, there were several dogs waiting, barking loudly and jumping over the fence, creating an unsettling environment for leaving my cat. I believe my impression would have been different if they had taken steps to calm the dogs and shown consideration for the cats (such as completely separating the waiting area or giving them priority). I was disappointed because if I had known the situation beforehand, I could have considered rescheduling.

I was particularly disappointed by the lack of consideration here, especially since another branch I visited provided excellent service.
The salon was clean, and the haircut and shampoo were done very well! The staff were also very kind and helpful!

This was my first visit.
The customer service was impeccably polite, and I didn't find the "slightly unsettling" aspect mentioned in other reviews to be a major issue.

However, the finished haircut was significantly different from the image I showed them beforehand. There was asymmetry, and instead of a nicely rounded shape, the head looked square, almost like a crew cut. I was very disappointed.

Because I wasn't satisfied with the result, I decided to have it corrected at another salon.

This was only the second grooming session, and I was really looking forward to the final result, so it's extremely disappointing.

I'm giving it 2 stars because I hope they can improve.
This was my dog's first grooming experience, and they did a thorough and speedy job. I'm very happy with the adorable result!

Today, my beloved cat made her salon debut! ✨ She received a shampoo, cypress bath, ear cleaning, nail trimming, and a herbal pack.

The staff were very kind.

They handled my cat gently, and even my timid and shy cat seemed to enjoy it.

She's so fluffy and clean now, and even cuter than before! I'm so happy.

I'll definitely use their services again!❣️

I requested grooming, a cypress wood bath, a herbal pack, and teeth cleaning.

My dog ​​finally got the ear-puff cut I'd always wanted!

I'm thrilled with how cute she looks – the cutest she's ever been!

The staff were all so kind, and my dog ​​seemed very happy!
It turned out so cute and exactly as I envisioned! The cypress wood bath made my pet incredibly fluffy! Thank you so much!

This was my first time having my toy poodle groomed here, and I'm extremely happy with the adorable and meticulous work they did!
They listened carefully to my requests for the cut, and my puppy came back looking super cute with a trendy, fluffy Korean-style fur. ✨
They also shared videos of my puppy enjoying the hot springs, during grooming, and getting along well with the staff, which was a nice surprise and I'm very grateful.

The staff were very kind and I felt completely at ease leaving my puppy with them. I would definitely like to use their services again!

This was my first time using this grooming salon, and the staff were all so kind that I felt completely at ease leaving my dog ​​in their care. The finished result was even cuter than I imagined; my dog ​​came back fluffy and adorable, and I'm extremely happy! They also carefully addressed my detailed requests, and my dog ​​seemed very relaxed. This is a salon I definitely want to continue using. I'm so glad I found such a wonderful place where I can confidently leave my precious family member. 🐶
He turned out so cute ^_^ He must have felt so good after taking a bath in the cypress bath, as he was fast asleep in my bag on the way home! Thank you so much ♪

Despite the short notice, you were so kind to me and treated me so well for all five days, and I'm truly grateful.
I could see that you were at ease and relaxed, which made me feel at ease as well.
I'd definitely like to request your services again. Thank you so much!

We've been using their services for about four years now.

This is a grooming salon where we can confidently entrust our beloved pet to their care!

The finished result is always so meticulous, and they're incredibly skilled at designing the cuts 💕
Not only do they make our pet look adorable, but I also love that the style lasts a long time ✨
It makes me happy when people compliment our pet's cuteness wherever we take them 🥰

The cypress bath here is a special time for our pet.

The subtle scent of cypress and the warm water seem to help them relax before grooming, and they look so comfortable every time ♨️

All the staff are kind and friendly, and in the four years we've been going there, I've never felt uneasy.

It's a favorite salon that I want to continue using for a long time to come 🐾

I'm worried about leaving my dog ​​with the staff because they seem unreliable.

They didn't do what I asked them to do, and they kept asking me about things I'd already told them. I felt uneasy leaving my dog ​​with them for several hours.

I used their services for the first time the other day.
Their technique was excellent, and they carefully and lovingly groomed my dog.
However, there were a few things that bothered me.
I think it's fine that the service was casual, but I didn't get the impression that they liked dogs at all. I felt uneasy about entrusting my dog ​​to them.
Lastly, I took advantage of the special treatment that was offered as a free service if you registered as a review, but after the treatment, I was asked to write a review right there in front of the staff. I don't think there are many Japanese people who are willing to enter a genuine review on the spot.
I felt that this was a bit disappointing, as their grooming techniques were solid.
Thank you very much for your courteous service.
They did a really cute job and explained everything so carefully!!!

I recently had my dog ​​groomed at Pet Hills ✨️
The cypress wood bath looked so relaxing!
The grooming was excellent; they gave him a cut similar to a Korean dog's, which I absolutely love.
He looks so fluffy and round and adorable now ✨️
The shop was also very clean, and I would definitely like to use their services again next time.

The staff were incredibly kind, and I felt completely at ease entrusting my hair to them!

They did a really cute job♪

I visited for a shampoo ☀️
It was my first time in a cypress wood bath, and I came back feeling incredibly soft and cute!
Thank you!

This was my first time using your grooming service!

The kind staff made me feel at ease leaving my dog ​​in your care.

I'm very happy with the finished result; she's so cute, silky smooth, and fluffy! The peach-tail cut has such a beautiful silhouette, she's adorable!
I was also grateful that they played with my dog ​​while I waited for pickup!

I look forward to using your services again next time!
I'm so glad I entrusted my beloved cat's first salon visit to them. They were very kind and attentive. She's so fluffy! I'll definitely use their services again!
Great for when you need a place that are willing to trim and groom cats.
This was my first time using their service, and they gave me a really cute haircut, exactly as I wanted! 🫶 …
The hairdresser is very gentle and has excellent skills! She speaks Chinese! The cat haircut is so cute!
I got a really cute haircut! I'd love to come back again!
The work was done beautifully, and I would like to use your services again next time.

I visited the salon for my 4th month debut. 
I wasn't scared of the location and I'm glad my hair became fluffy!

I've been using their services for about a year and a half, and I'm always very satisfied because they do such a beautiful job every time! They even take photos after the haircut and videos while I'm in the bath, which I use for Instagram.
I occasionally stay overnight as well, and they take such good care of my pet, so I feel completely at ease. 🙂‍↕️
I definitely want to continue using their services! 🌟
They always do such a lovely job! ♡ The customer service is also very polite, so I feel completely at ease leaving my dog ​​with them!
The shop had a calm atmosphere, and I got a cute haircut.

The haircut was very cute. 
The bath looked nice too, which was good.
The cypress scented bath was so relaxing! My hair became so soft and smooth, I'm very satisfied!
The work was done with kindness and care. The staff were very kind.
They were very thorough with their work, and the cut was fluffy and cute. They sent me lots of photos and videos, so I was very satisfied.

Today, I visited the Aoyama store.
It was very clean, and the pet resting area was spacious...
It seemed like a good place to wait comfortably!
I would like to use the Aoyama store again.

A grooming salon opened in my neighborhood, so I was curious and visited for the first time. The staff were very kind, and they did a great job grooming my dog, making him look adorable.
When I peeked inside to pick him up, I saw the staff playing with him affectionately, and it warmed my heart to see how much they love dogs.
They also took lots of photos and videos, which I was very happy about.
I think I'll be using their services more often in the future.

Thank you so much! ♡

They are so kind and gentle, and they do such a lovely job with the grooming!
I feel completely at ease leaving my pet there.

Thank you so much as always! ☺️

We visited Pet Hills, the pet shop we've been going to since our dog was a puppy, as they've opened a new store!

It's very clean and has a large free space. When we went to pick up our dog, she was happily playing as usual 🐕
She's a Pomeranian-Shiba Inu and doesn't have much hair to cut, but they always give her a cute, neat, and unique haircut ♡

Today was my first time getting my dog ​​groomed at the Aoyama store!

I'm very happy with the lovely salon and the cute grooming they did!

I'll definitely be back!

This was our first time using their services♪ My children seemed to enjoy the bright, glass-walled shop (*^ω^*)
They received a cypress bath and a herbal pack, and their haircut was done exactly as requested, making them look very cute✨
I'm happy to see them enjoying their massage so much☺️
I felt completely at ease leaving them in their care✨
Everyone's cutting skills are amazing, and I'm very happy with how fluffy my hair turned out. Thank you as always!
Thank you as always for the cute trimming! I'd love to see you again!
They were very kind and did a great job with the haircut 🌸 …
I made it cute ^_^

PEThills, a dog groomer I always go to, recently opened their Aoyama branch, so I headed over right away! ✨
The Aoyama branch is even larger, and the dogs were able to play freely after their trimming! ✨
PEThills always gives me exactly the cut I want, so I've been going there for a while.
If you're interested, be sure to check it out! ♥

I opted for the shampoo course.

The salon is brand new and very clean and tidy.

They also explained the course options thoroughly.

I will definitely use their services again!

Thank you!

I had my dog ​​groomed at the new shop 🐶
They made her look so cute 💖
I'll definitely be back again ✨✨✨ …

I visited a newly opened salon in my neighborhood for the first time, and I was thrilled with the adorable makeover. The staff were incredibly kind, and I was very satisfied with the photo and video services.

I will definitely make another reservation. Thank you!

I had my cat groomed! I had it done at the Shibuya branch before, and now that the Aoyama branch has opened, I asked them to do it, and they did a lovely job again! I'm so happy that you sent me some videos and photos! Thank you so much🙇‍♀️ …

I went to the newly opened Aoyama store last week for my favorite cypress bath and a grooming session. 
I was very satisfied with the Bichon cut, which gave my dog ​​a nice rounded shape. The store was spacious and there was plenty of room for him to run around, so I'll definitely come back next time I'm staying at a hotel.

I've been a customer since their previous location 🐶❤️
Not only do they make my dog ​​look so cute, but I also feel completely at ease entrusting my dog ​​to them because of their kind service and meticulous finishing touches 🐾
I look forward to continuing to use their services in the future ❤️

The finished product is absolutely adorable. They even noticed details I hadn't thought of.

I'll definitely use your services again. Thank you so much!

I had my dog ​​groomed at the new store 🐶
I'm so happy with how fluffy, smelly, and cute she looks ☺️ I'll definitely be back 🙇🏻‍♀️🐾 …
They both looked absolutely adorable!

I went to Pet Hills, the pet grooming salon we've been going to since my puppy was little, because they've opened a new location in Aoyama (right near Gaienmae Station).

The shop is beautiful, and because it has glass walls, you can see inside from the outside. It was so cute to see my puppy spot me when I came to pick him up. I'm very happy with the grooming result; they always give puppies that adorable little ear trim!

I've been a customer for about two years now.

I visited the newly opened Aoyama branch, and once again, the result was absolutely beautiful!

Before coming here, I often struggled to find a Korean-style haircut that I was happy with, but Pet Hills always gives me a fantastic result!

They also send me cute photos every time!

If you like the Korean-style haircut with the raised ears, you should definitely give them a try!
It looks cute for Christmas 🎄 …
The Bichon Frise cut is done very well!
very lovely pet salon💕high quality hair cut …
